A house beside a tall tower becomes a chapel. Four blocks stacked by the sea become a lighthouse. Place a few blocks and they turn into a town. What each one becomes depends on where you put it. A house beside a tall tower becomes a chapel. Four blocks stacked by the sea become a lighthouse. A path becomes a street, with lamps and benches along it.|放置方块就能建成小镇。它们变成什么取决于放置位置。高塔旁的房屋变成小教堂，海边四层方块变成灯塔，小路变成有街灯和长椅的街道。

Then people move in. The miller carries flour down to the bakery, and the baker takes the bread to the stall on the square. Boats go out in the morning and come back with fish. Washing goes up on the lines. Some days there's a market. Sometimes there's a wedding.|居民陆续搬入。磨坊工把面粉送到面包店，面包师把面包送往广场摊位。船只早晨出海，载鱼归来。衣物挂上晾衣绳，有时举办集市，有时举办婚礼。
